versions.changelog:
Initial release of Pomodoist skill.

- Manage Pomodoist tasks, projects, deadlines, and Focus sessions via a secure OpenClaw MCP connection.
- Read and resolve all data (tasks, projects, etc.) using native MCP tools without inventing IDs or data.
- Explain setup steps for connecting to Pomodoist Cloud or self-hosted MCP endpoints.
- Explicitly require user confirmation before writes, destructive actions, or enabling Focus controls.
- All changes follow strict confirmation and access control, never using legacy or unauthorized mutations.
- Clearly separate scheduled work from deadlines, handle time zones, and prevent data leakage.
